name: SEOScore — API on RapidAPI
description:
Audit any web page for SEO and AI-search (GEO) readiness in one call: SEOScore returns an SEO score, a GEO score and per-check findings with fix guidance, for a single URL or a batch of up to 25.

What you get:
- SEO score covering titles, meta, headings, links, images and technical basics
- GEO score for AI-answer visibility: structured data, answer-ready content signals and machine-readable files such as llms.txt
- Every failing check returned with concrete fix guidance, not just a number
- Batch audits in the same format, for agency sweeps and pre-publish gates

Key endpoints:
- POST /audit — audit one URL
- POST /audit/batch — audit up to 25 URLs in one call
- GET /audit?url= — audit one URL via query string

Plans: BASIC is free with 200 calls per month. PRO is $9/month for 10,000 calls. ULTRA is $29/month for 50,000 calls plus $0.001 per additional call.

Access: subscribe on RapidAPI (free tier available); calls are made over HTTPS with your RapidAPI key.
